bodies.scope: Consensus RPC throttle pruning removes rows only when the supplied current triple is strictly later than a helper-derived deadline using a30.0-second duration argument. Both flat and tree forms use signed comparison for the first word and unsigned comparison for the remaining words, retain equality, and collect40-byte diagnostics only from expired rows with raw flag exactly1. Date helper internals, generic map repair, cadence scheduling and full consensus behavior remain outside the claim.
